title: The Old Prophet in Bethel
description: An old prophet in Bethel deceives the man of God from Judah into returning and eating with him by lying that an angel had given him a new message from the Lord. The man of God thus disobeys the Lord's command, and during the meal the word of the Lord comes to the old prophet with judgment: the man of God shall not be buried in his ancestors' tomb. On his way home he is killed by a lion, which neither touches the body nor the donkey.
